title: S Nash 4BR 2Bath 6Beds Near Downtown Airport Vandy
description:
Big 4BR 2BA Economically priced Duplex apt 8 minutes from downtown.  6 SEPARATE BEDS!  Sofa+Love Seat.  2 Full Baths also!  Has Washer & Dryer!  Offstreet parking in long driveway with Carport. This is a newly renovated older home in a quiet neighborhood in south Nashville half of a Large duplex.  2BR 1BA Garage apartment also avail for extra $ Only 4 miles to Broadway or Vandy!  Approx $10 Uber to downtown

The space
There are 4 Bedrooms and 2 Baths with a central kitchen.  A carport outside can keep you out of the rain when unloading!  NOTE:  Bedroom #4 is only accessible through Bedroom #3 BUT there is a door separating both for privacy.  Bedrooms 1, 2, and 3 all have private access to bathrooms.

STRP#2017009070

Guest access
Has covered parking just outside kitchen door for easy loading and unloading. Laundry room located in Bedroom one.
STRP#2017009070A

Other things to note
House Rules: 
**NO SMOKING IN SIDE OR NEAR DOORS!! If we find any evidence of smoking in this home, either by smell or paraphernalia, you lose security deposit.
No guests at anytime not included in the reservation guest count even if they dont stay the night.
Outside quiet hours dark until 9:00 a.m.
No loud voices, music, or celebrating outside at any time.
Noise complaint/police called = forfeited deposit.
No more than 2 unregistered guests in the house at any time.
No parking in the grass. Keep all vehicles on concrete areas.
